questions.q: A chair costs ₹2,700 cash or ₹600 down plus 3 monthly instalments of ₹750. The extra money paid under the instalment plan is —
The price paid if the whole amount is paid at once is called the —
questions.work: The cash price is the full price paid immediately in cash.

questions.q: An article costs ₹5,000 cash; under a plan the buyer pays ₹1,000 down. The balance owed is —
A table costs ₹1,700 cash or ₹500 down and ₹1,400 after 2 months. The interest charged is —
questions.work:
Balance = 1700 − 500 = ₹1,200.
The buyer pays ₹1,400 for it, so interest = 1400 − 1200 = ₹200.

questions.q: A fan costs ₹1,500 cash or ₹360 down + 3 monthly instalments of ₹390. The interest charged is —
The total amount paid under an instalment plan is —
options: cash down + sum of the instalments
questions.work: The buyer pays the cash down at once and then all the instalments, so total = cash down + sum of instalments.

sections.title: Objective type questions: each has two parts of 1 mark (fill in the blanks, match the columns or true/false).

questions.q: Fill in the blanks: (i) Under an instalment plan, the part paid at the time of purchase is the ____. (ii) Interest charged = sum of instalments − ____.
questions.answer:
(i) cash down payment.
(ii) balance (= cash price − cash down), because the instalments repay the balance plus interest.

questions.q: Write True or False: (i) Under an instalment plan the buyer usually pays more than the cash price. (ii) Interest under an instalment plan is charged on the full cash price for the whole period.
questions.answer:
(i) True: the extra is interest for the delayed payment.
(ii) False: interest is charged only on the amount still owed, which falls after each instalment.

questions.q: A TV costs ₹20,000 cash, or ₹5,000 down and ₹15,500 after 4 months. Fill in: (i) interest ____ (ii) rate of interest ____ p.a.

sections.passage: A washing machine costs ₹19,400. In a Diwali sale it is available for ₹4,200 cash down followed by three equal monthly instalments. The shopkeeper charges interest at 16% per annum under this plan. Let each instalment be ₹x.

questions.q: A chair is available for ₹2,700 cash or ₹600 cash down followed by 3 monthly instalments of ₹750. Find the interest charged under the plan.
A table is available for ₹1,700 cash or ₹500 down and ₹1,400 after 2 months. Find the rate of interest charged.
A sewing machine is sold for ₹7,500 cash down and ₹4,360 after 6 months. If interest is charged at 18% per annum, find the cash price.
questions.answer:
Let the cash price be ₹C; balance = C − 7500.
Amount after 6 months = balance × (1 + 18 × ½/100) = 1.09 × (C − 7500).
1.09(C − 7500) = 4360 ⇒ C − 7500 = 4000 ⇒ C = ₹11,500.

or.q: A mixer costs ₹8,000 cash or ₹2,000 down and ₹6,240 after 3 months. Find the rate of interest.

questions.q: A camera is bought for ₹5,000 cash down and ₹21,000 after 3 months. If interest is 20% per annum, find the cash price.
questions.answer:
Let the cash price be C; balance = C − 5000.
Interest for 3 months at 20% = 20 × 3/12 = 5%, so 21000 = 1.05(C − 5000).
C − 5000 = 20000 ⇒ C = ₹25,000.

questions.q: A radio costs ₹1,000 cash or ₹400 down and ₹630 after 6 months. Find the rate of interest.
questions.answer:
Balance = ₹600; interest = 630 − 600 = ₹30 for ½ year.
30 = 600 × R × ½/100 = 3R ⇒ R = 10% per annum.

questions.q: A fan is available for ₹1,500 cash or ₹360 cash down followed by three monthly instalments of ₹390 each. Find the rate of interest per annum under the plan.
A washing machine is available for ₹13,500 cash or ₹6,500 cash down followed by three monthly instalments of ₹2,500. Find the rate of interest.
A cooler costs ₹6,000 cash or ₹2,000 down and two equal monthly instalments. If interest is 12% per annum (simple), find each instalment.
A washing machine costs ₹15,000 cash or ₹2,250 cash down followed by two equal half-yearly instalments. If the interest charged is 8% per annum compounded half-yearly, find each instalment.
questions.answer:
Balance = 15000 − 2250 = ₹12,750. Rate per half-year = 4%.
The balance equals the present value of the two instalments x:
x/1.04 + x/(1.04)² = 12750.
Multiply by (1.04)² = 1.0816: 1.04x + x = 12750 × 1.0816 ⇒ 2.04x = 13,790.40 ⇒ x = ₹6,760.
Each half-yearly instalment is ₹6,760.
